title: Watch the trailer for ‘The Greatest,’ the Muhammad Ali series coming to Prime Video November 4

---


## Key takeaways


- The Greatest


is streaming now on Prime Video worldwide. Watch the trailer above.


- The biopic is the first authorized scripted series about Muhammad Ali's life and is executive produced by his widow Lonnie Ali.


- Jaalen Best stars as Ali, with Michael B. Jordan's Outlier Society among the producers.


---


The Greatest


, the biopic series about the legendary Muhammad Ali, is now streaming on


[Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/prime-video) .


With unprecedented access to Ali's estate, it is the first authorized scripted series about the life of the global icon, boxing champion, and humanitarian.


Here’s everything you need to know about


The Greatest


.


## What is ‘The Greatest’ about?


The Greatest


is an intimate exploration of the incomparable life of the boxing champion, humanitarian, and global icon Muhammad Ali. It is the first authorized scripted series about his life offering unprecedented access, going beyond the amazing victories and defeats that made Ali a legend, both in and out of the ring.


The heartbeat of the story is fueled by all the moments that took place outside of the spotlight. The world remembers an icon, but


The Greatest


is about a man, a husband, a father, a brother, and a son.


## Who is in ‘The Greatest’ cast?


The series stars:


- Jaalen Best (


[All American: Homecoming](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0B7C4MM4D?pageTypeId=B0B7BRY13C&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_srfd6f9a_1_1_1&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&qid=1791899336866&sr=1-1) ) as Cassius Clay/Muhammad Ali


- Omari Hardwick (


[Power](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0H113LGVJ?pageTypeId=B0H11D4PQG&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_srfd6f9a_2_1_1&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&qid=1791899368105&sr=1-1) ) as Cassius Clay Sr.


- Dana Gourrier (


[Django Unchained](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0GS2NZFBG?pageTypeId=B0GXGNYKCH&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&qid=1791899403932&sr=1-1&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_sr9f90f0_1_1_1) ) as Odessa 'Bird' Clay


- Amin Joseph (


[Snowfall](https://www.amazon.com/Snowfall/dp/B0B8MYM9JK/ref=sr_1_1?crid=4B3LURMQFKE2&dib=eyJ2IjoiMSJ9.jJQ0rp9dzdBveIlAi9DkJqgR-w_GIiTI5omSGHQc6qXa5XL9anSnVRt6yuGNg45tf9mXIEQn0XS5Vdkjl0uNbbl08GcVyU0i0P8cL-IOfxHJev0Wf92eRdVilC7S4IN1IW7TO_d8meBrux2mJWhIGJCjK6DJx139mpwjrpWxJ6gDj8pmaABrRd9PGQObrkGptrm7cHweBInKve1KW3gUFmySuiJl4yfubnoaIermq6c.5iCGFyE25GWg4_TDPXio7It4W4lXhQcpPVY4wcS3nSI&dib_tag=se&keywords=snowfall&qid=1791969513&sprefix=snowfall%2Caps%2C177&sr=8-1) ) as Sonny Liston


- Kai Parham (


Vows


) as Rudy Clay


- Michael Ealy (


[Barbershop](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0GY1TXJPZ?pageTypeId=B0GY1SJHWY&qid=1791899493284&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_srfd6f9a_1_1_1&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&sr=1-1) ) as Malcolm X


- Giovanni Ribisi (


[Avatar](https://www.primevideo.com/detail/0FOV7LGJKLMUN334YPCSP57UWI) ) as Angelo Dundee

## Who is the team behind ‘The Greatest’?


Ben Watkins (


[Cross](https://www.amazon.com/Cross/dp/B0D6H1NDST/ref=sr_1_1?crid=GV23R41V4UZH&dib=eyJ2IjoiMSJ9.s8zMcvBc7JdvBh0MFrhpn-FLkfE6Jm-Re5QlEDBfvqFWpWwiKwBLdADtPChRVJPkD8dutTC7d2xyiRDm9fVvz6GtlmD_zkcLRrWG2TTn8546gorHtp_hvZMI_OBJrJ5ZmrUkni69xq0hi70TOjjnEQAkmvo-faGaSf5B4R8yTN5S-fNySzvRbpr9FjXuaBmFLt4GUUlNVla8jaar0EuayCVB8bwWRtPhXCDwaNGgpjU.2aFm2ZSZg-bWqjUgekzjBve46r0ngqXSEj5YHF_hkrs&dib_tag=se&keywords=cross+prime+video&qid=1791899951&sprefix=cross+prime+vid%2Caps%2C202&sr=8-1) ) serves as creator, showrunner, and executive producer on the series through his company Blue Monday Productions.


Michael B. Jordan’s (


[Creed](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0FN83YDQG?ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_sr62ef6f_1_1_1&pageTypeId=B0FN83YDQG&qid=1791900203413&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&sr=1-1) ) Outlier Society also produces alongside Authentic Studios, Roc Nation, Polygram Entertainment (a Universal Music Group partner), and Grace: A Storytelling Company.


The show is also executive produced by Lonnie Ali, the widow of the late legend, with access to the estate of Ali.
